scope: First narrow implementation: case government, postposition case, possessor/person/question scope. Word-order/focus experiment deferred as proposed.
candidate_inventory: Fresh P1 combined candidates; identical inventory across every arm. TRAIN cache is regenerated from the same analyzer.
training_source: 3260 IMST TRAIN sentences only. No MAIN, DEV, CALIB or TEST labels in fitting.
frames: TRAIN dependency-observed verb lemma+voice case distributions; not exhaustive sense-specific valency and never hard constraints.

A1.method: Separate partial-label local grammar residual for government, agreement and combined

A3.method: Two fixed mining/fitting rounds of structured squared-hinge grammar residual ranking
A3.context_selection: SHA256 of TRAIN context id; eligible strict view-positive contrast and observable grammar evidence
A3.scope: Mine with current full decoder; reference gates and retained configurations frozen only within each mining round, then recomputed

selection: Native lemma+POS and native declared features must not decrease; wrong committed lemma decisions must not increase versus P2, and projected lemma+POS must not decrease. Among safe arms maximize projected lemma+POS, then projected features, native lemma+POS, then prefer simpler/zero contribution.

A2.scope: Inherited native lemma+POS and declared feature abstention; lexical-view confidence is not calibrated by this gate

CALIB: Baseline plus one DEV-sealed arm; no retuning based on CALIB. If historical nonregression fails, retain P2 and report the exploratory arm.
guards: No candidate deletion or label rewriting
All bound factors depend on actual chosen candidates
Counterexample probes are diagnostic, not an independent test
Candidate coverage and retained-plan coverage separately
